note: Wooded RV park on Triplett Rd off SR-31 near I-75 exit 143, North Fort Myers, with Popash Creek running through it. --Claude
summary: Operator's pages: confirmed $85/day summer rate (2025/2026 rate page); added 129 sites with pull-throughs, showers/flush toilets/laundry/store/WiFi, reservable by request form or phone. Winter is priced by the month only. Note trimmed of price/hookup text. Not stated: electric amperage (30/50 left as derived), Good Sam discount (derived left), season.
flags: Long-stay (Fort Myers exception, no price gate): winter (2025/2026) is priced only by the month ($1,500-1,800/month, one month's deposit) - no nightly winter rate is posted, so a passing traveller may not be able to buy a winter night. Summer sells by the day ($85). The reservation request form also asks the rig's Year (possible rig-age screening; no rule stated).
Water re-audit lead: the operator says Pop Ash Creek 'runs through the Park ... offering up over 47 creek side campsites' and '129 Sites - on and off the creek'; entry is 'not waterfront'.
Website is an old Homestead site (2014-2015 policy PDF, 2012-2013 photo album link) but carries current 2025/2026 winter rates and the phone, so it is live.
